g.aria-label: Step 1: Single Centered Flip Zᵢ ∈ {−½, +½} Has Gaussian-Bounded MGF
Step 2: Chernoff on Sum of n Independent Flips Factorizes Into Product
P(p̂ − ½ ≥ t) ≤ e^-λnt ∏ᵢ E[e^λZᵢ] ≤ exp( −λnt + nλ²/8 )
Step 3: Minimize Parabola Over λ > 0 at Vertex λ* = 4t
−(4t)nt + n(4t)²/8 = −2nt² ⇒ P( |p̂ − ½| ≥ t ) ≤ 2 exp( −2 n t² )
